newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe dollar ends week mixed on hard units.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe dollar ends week mixed on hard units.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed the week on Friday easier on the U.S. dollar and the rand but was quoted firmer against European currencies, dealers said.
"Today was fairly quiet but rather surprisingly the Zimbabwe dollar lost against the U.S. dollar. We had early buyers at around 0900 (0700 GMT) but that was all I saw," said one dealer.
"I suppose most banks were a bit short and were trying to protect their positions (ahead of the weekend)," he added.

At Friday"s close, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.0400/0500 against the U.S. dollar, a cent down from 11.0300/0400 on Thursday and also eased to 2.5020/5060 from 2.5000/5200 versus neighbouring South Africa"s rand.
It however firmed against European currencies, finishing at 17.8890/9185 from 17.9900/18.0200 against sterling and at 6.5495/5580 on the mark, slightly up from 6.5500/5600 the previous day.
